newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila okays Belgian bank's representative office.
newsitem.headline: Manila okays Belgian bank's representative office.

text.p: The Philippine Monetary Board had approved the application of Belgium's Generale Bank to put up a representative office in the country, Central Bank deputy governor Edgardo Zialcita said on Monday.
Zialcita said in a statement Generale Bank helped finance the construction of a $1 billion power plant in Pangasinan on northern Luzon island.
In 1980, the bank also helped finance the construction of a light rail transit in Manila and the construction of a phosporic acid plant of Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corp, it said.

The Central Bank statement quoted Generale managing director Paul Catteau as saying the strong growth in the Philippine economy in the past two years had encouraged Belgian companies to develop business in the Philippines.
